items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a tax exemption (Data Center Sales Tax Exemption or JCTC-type exemption) of 1.972% for 10 years on 2024-04-29 for a project in the City of Cleveland, Cuyahoga County. Commitment: create 200 full-time equivalent employees generating $15,000,000 in new annual payroll
